niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces with clear hierarchy, readable contrast, and polished structure. They often favor light neutral backgrounds with dark text, but in some contexts also like dark navy treatments when they are clean, high-contrast, and restrained rather than flashy. They repeatedly prefer spacious layouts, rounded corners, strong primary-action emphasis, clearer grouping into cards/sheets/modals, and interfaces that feel refined, calm, and focused rather than cluttered, noisy, overly decorative, or weakly organized.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong visual hierarchy with clear titles, subtitles, labels, metadata placement, section headings, and scan-friendly structure.
Prefers more open spacing, less crowding, clearer separation between sections, and breathable content blocks.
Most often prefers light neutral backgrounds with dark, legible text; when dark themes are preferred, they still need strong contrast, clarity, and restraint.
Prefers larger corner radius, pill-shaped or softly rounded controls, cards, sheets, and containers over squarer geometry.
Prefers obvious, prominent primary CTAs with stronger contrast, size, placement, or saturation, while secondary actions stay visually subordinate.
Prefers content organized into clear cards, grouped sections, bottom sheets, or centered modals with distinct containment and focal framing.
Prefers enough detail to feel informative and guided, but presented in a concise, organized way rather than dense, cluttered, or overly minimal layouts.
